query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clients) AS total_clients,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT clientId) FROM transactions) AS clients_with_tx,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions) AS total_tx,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoiceNumber) FROM transactions WHERE invoiceNumber IS NOT NULL) AS invoices,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM transactions) AS total_revenue,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tools) AS total_tools;
